findings.title: --enable-legacy-workloads Go default (false) contradicts the documented/chart default (true)
deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml stale vs config/manager/manager.yaml; broke the lint job
Legacy workload kinds are refused when the flag is off (the author's fix for the original Forbidden-loop finding)
One legacy role makes preCheck fail the WHOLE RBG, so healthy RoleInstanceSet roles in the same group never reconcile and cleanup is never reached
findings.canaryNote: PASSES today (documents the fail-closed-whole-group behavior). When the author moves to per-role degradation or admission-time rejection this test FLIPS TO RED -- that means FIXED; invert the assertion then.
findings.liveEvidence: flag off, RBG with 1 legacy + 1 RoleInstanceSet role: 28 rejections, 14 Reconciler error, NO RoleInstanceSet created for the healthy role in 60s

findings.title: deleteOrphanRoles skips legacy cleanup when the flag is off, so the controller no longer removes RBG-owned legacy workloads left by a migrated role
findings.harnessBites: The control_legacyEnabled_orphanIsCleanedUp subtest passes (the orphan IS deleted with the flag on), proving the test exercises CleanupOrphanedWorkloads rather than failing for an unrelated reason.
findings.liveNote: INCONCLUSIVE live: on the ACK test cluster the orphaned Deployment is removed within ~10s in BOTH modes with 0 controller delete attempts, and also with NO controller running at all (gccontrol.sh) -- Kubernetes GC is the actor, so the live test cannot discriminate. The leaks indefinitely framing is NOT evidence-backed; only the code-level skip is proven. Any fix must also retain delete RBAC for legacy types, else cleanup 403s.

findings.title: cacheOptions(false) drops the group-name label selector for Deployment/StatefulSet, leaving a latent unfiltered cluster-wide informer
findings.canaryNote: Latent on this head: the F3a reject removes the only reachable cached read path for legacy types. Keeping the selector regardless of the flag costs nothing. Test PASSES today; FLIPS if a bounded selector or DefaultLabelSelector is added.

findings.title: DISPROVED: Helm guard asymmetry between manager.yaml (default dict/hasKey) and clusterrole.yaml (direct deref)
findings.evidence: Rendered 4 value shapes with helm 3.16.3 (default, enabled=false, legacyWorkloads={}, features={}). Helm value coalescing restores chart defaults; all non-false shapes render byte-identical to default. No nil-pointer, no flag/RBAC mismatch.

liveNote: L3 needs a real cluster and ALWAYS finish with 90-live-teardown.sh. Scripts abort loudly on the four traps that produced void runs here: FIXTURE INVALID (wrong annotation prefix -- v1alpha2 uses rbg.workloads.x-k8s.io/, not rolebasedgroup.workloads.x-k8s.io/), CONTROLLER VOID (expired SA token -> Unauthorized, or CRDs older than the PR Go types -> cannot unmarshal restartPolicy), TREE DIRTY (binary not built from the code under review), and a leftover controller from a prior run. Cluster used: ACK cn-hongkong, k8s v1.36.1; its CRDs were upgraded to the PR version and are not reverted. LWS CRD absent, so the LWS arm of F3a is unit-only.
